reason: Start with the craft illustrations to explore how printing makes practical knowledge accessible.
expectation: I expect a printed presentation of craft techniques, possibly leading to connections with other knowledge.

alternatives.reason: Public participation also addresses a goal, but I chose to begin with how knowledge is shared.

effect: Craft is now part of the public reference work; linking its articles looks like the next step toward the knowledge-connection goal.
reaction: The inclusion of practical making alongside learned knowledge is interesting.
reason: Link the craft account to other branches of knowledge to pursue the first goal.
expectation: I expect a connected reference work showing how craft relates to other fields.

alternatives.reason: Public readers answering back addresses the other goal, but I want to finish the knowledge connection first.

effect: Cross-references completed the knowledge-connection goal; the remaining goal concerns public challenges.
reaction: The idea of multiple routes through knowledge is appealing.
reason: This is the only offered combination and addresses who can challenge public arguments.
expectation: I expect readers outside universities to be able to raise objections and participate in debate.

effect: The wider-public argument completed the remaining goal, while clarifying that broader discussion does not guarantee equal participation.
reaction: That qualification made the conclusion more useful than a simple celebration of public debate.

mostWorthwhile.text: Linking articles through cross-references was most worthwhile: it showed how readers can take different routes between subjects and practices.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial craft combination was the least engaging; it established inclusion in a reference work but gave little detail about the craft illustrations themselves.

surprise.text: The final result distinguished opening arguments to a wider public from achieving equal participation, a useful limit on the idea of public knowledge.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though the final combination was the only offered action, so choosing it did not require much deliberation.

continue.text: I would continue: the connections between practical knowledge, access and criticism are interesting, though I would hope for more consequential choices.
